declaration.statement: Represent the windowed mansard roof as a setback orthogonal occupied attic level and represent the raised transverse roof mass as electrical/mechanical ancillary space.
declaration.reason: The source kernel accepts orthogonal vertical walls and flat caps; this preserves distinct roof volumes and use hypotheses while omitting the pitched and curved surface shape.
missing_information: Roof construction, true machinery layout and the exact boundary between usable rooms and roof voids
